puremetal.options.renderScale.readout: Draws the world at %1$s×%2$s, then enlarges it to fill your screen (%3$s×%4$s).
puremetal.options.renderScale.readout.na: Draws the world at your full screen size (%1$s×%2$s). No upscaling.
puremetal.options.renderScale.tooltip: Fewer pixels = less GPU work = higher FPS. Menus and HUD stay sharp.
puremetal.options.upscaler.temporal.shad: Unavailable with shader packs; using Bilinear.
puremetal.options.upscaler.temporal.unsu: MetalFX couldn't start on this Mac; using Bilinear.
puremetal.options.upscaler.temporal.hook: Another mod changed rendering; using Bilinear.
puremetal.options.upscaler.note100: Upscalers only apply below 100% Render Scale.
puremetal.options.upscaler.tooltip:
Bilinear: fastest, softest.
MetalFX Spatial: sharper, costs a little FPS on M1/M2.
MetalFX Temporal: sharpest, may ghost on fast motion.
puremetal.options.metal4.tooltip:
Metal 3 (off): the default. Stable and currently the fastest option.
Metal 4 (on): Apple's newer GPU API. Experimental, usually slower for now and may have visual glitches. Needs macOS 26 and an M1 or newer.
Restart the game after changing this.
puremetal.options.metal4.unsupported: Requires macOS 26 or newer on Apple silicon. Metal 4 is unavailable on this system.
puremetal.options.note: Pure Metal already boosts FPS on its own. These settings are optional extras.
puremetal.options.inactive: Inactive: Pure Metal is not running.
puremetal.options.terrainLod.tooltip: Simplifies far terrain at Render Distance 16+. Nearby terrain stays full detail; distant solid blocks are drawn as bigger blocks. Water, plants, leaves and glass are unchanged.
puremetal.options.terrainLodRatio.toolti: Share of Render Distance kept at full detail. Lower simplifies more terrain.
puremetal.options.generationFpsCap.toolt: In singleplayer, while new terrain generates, limits FPS to twice your display's refresh rate (at most 259). The freed CPU time generates chunks faster. Normal FPS returns about 2 seconds after generation stops.
